We present an efficient algorithm for multi-label ranking based on the idea of block coordinate descent.
Conventional approaches implement multi-label learning as a set of binary classification problems, but they suffer from imbalanced data distributions when the number of classes is large.
Multi-label learning is useful in visual object recognition when several objects are present in an image.
In this paper, we address multi-label learning with many classes via a ranking approach, termed multi-label ranking.
